sources.finding: Authors identify DPO length sensitivity and evaluate a modified objective on larger base/instruct models. Their gains do not establish an improvement for this character task.

implication: Report generated response lengths, finish reasons, and terse-instruction behavior alongside the unchanged character rubric.
